description: This file contains the implementation of a dummy (no-operation) PDF filter class, 'NoOpFiler', which inherits from an abstract 'Filter' class, and provides trivial 'Encode' and 'Decode' methods that clone the input data.

classes.name: NoOpFiler
classes.description: An implementation of a dummy filter used when no actual filtering is required, simply returning copies of input data.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Returns a copy of the input byte array.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Returns a copy of the input byte array, ignoring filter parameters.
